categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Weihong Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of industrial motion control systems, servo drive systems, and industrial IoT solutions. Its products are mainly applied in CNC machine tools, including lathes, engraving and milling machines, cutting machines, and industrial robots, serving industries such as furniture decoration, electronics, sheet metal, automotive, medical devices, footwear, advertising, energy, metallurgy, and transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary high-speed, high-precision motion control technology for complex curved surfaces, integrating software and hardware with core intellectual property rights. Its products include motion controllers (cards and integrated controllers) and digital servo drives using advanced DSP-based algorithms for precise torque, speed, and position control. Production combines in-house manufacturing of high-technology components with outsourced PCBA processing, following an 'independent production plus external processing' model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of CNC machine tools and automated processing equipment across diverse sectors such as metal cutting, laser processing, furniture, electronics (3C), automotive, medical devices, and industrial automation. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and some international clients, with a focus on providing customized solutions to meet specific industry needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales and operations in major economic regions including the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Bohai Rim. It also has overseas presence through subsidiaries such as Weihong Technology Pte. Ltd. in Singapore, supporting international expansion and global market engagement.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Weihong operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial automation supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of core motion control hardware and software components that are integrated into CNC machine tools and automated equipment by downstream OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in motion control and servo drive technologies, expanding product lines to cover higher power servo drives and advanced CNC systems with EtherCAT bus technology. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance product performance, customization capabilities, and to develop new solutions in laser processing and digital manufacturing. Strategic priorities include deepening market penetration in metal cutting and laser processing, expanding application scenarios, and pursuing internationalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of hardware products such as motion control cards, integrated controllers, and servo drives. The company employs a direct sales model supported by regional marketing and technical service teams. Additional revenue streams include technical services, customized product development, and investment income from securities and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Weihong is recognized as one of the leading domestic companies specializing in motion control technology in China, with a strong brand presence in niche markets like engraving, milling, waterjet cutting, and laser cutting. It competes with both domestic and foreign suppliers of CNC control systems and servo drives, leveraging its proprietary technology and direct sales model to maintain competitive advantages in precision and customization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 465.7 million, representing a 5.53% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 141.38% to RMB 95.4 million. The company maintains a stable asset base of around RMB 945 million with a net asset value of RMB 773 million, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability driven by product innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its proprietary high-speed, high-precision motion control technology tailored for complex curved surface machining, offering superior real-time control algorithms and system integration. Its open software architecture combined with hardware innovation enables flexible customization to meet diverse customer needs. The direct sales and service network ensures close customer engagement, rapid technical support, and tailored solutions, enhancing customer loyalty and competitive positioning.
